stories.title: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas raises $9 million for AI startup M
stories.summary: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas has raised $9 million for his AI-powered household concierge startup, M. The round was led by RTP Global, which contributed $5 million. This latest injection brings the company's total funding to approximately $20 million. The startup remains quiet on its specific plans.

stories.title: Exclusive: Kabeer Biswas' M Raises $9 Mn Led By RTP Global
stories.summary: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas’ AI startup M has raised $9 Mn (₹82 Cr) in a fresh funding round led by VC firm RTP Global, sources familiar with the development told Inc42. Existing investors of the startup, including Peak XV Partners and Blume Ventures, also doubled down on their erstwhile bets.

stories.summary: Dubai-based XEBO.ai has raised $10.5 million in its first institutional funding round, led by the Emirates Growth Fund. The company plans to use the capital to expand its AI-powered customer experience platform into North America, with a long-term goal of reaching $100 million in annual recurring revenue.

stories.title: Avicena raises $100 million for optical interconnect technology
stories.summary: Avicena has raised over $100 million in a Series C round led by InterVest. The startup develops technology to move data between chips and memory in AI data centers using light. Backers include corporate investment arms from SK hynix, Samsung, and Mitsubishi Chemical.

stories.summary: Every, a media and software company focused on AI in the workplace, has raised $17.5 million at a $110 million valuation. Led by IA Ventures, the 35-person firm combines AI testing with content and consulting. Investors include the chief executive of The Atlantic and Betaworks.

stories.summary: Thermal energy storage startup Good Heat has raised $2.2 million in a round led by SET Ventures. The company develops and operates heat batteries for industrial facilities and currently holds a project pipeline exceeding 175 MW across Europe and Australia. Shell Ventures also participated in the round.

stories.title: Warsaw water-monitoring startup raises €5.75 million
stories.summary: A Warsaw-based startup has raised €5.75 million in a pre-seed round co-led by b2venture and Movens Capital. The funding includes €3.5 million in non-dilutive government grants. The company uses autonomous stations and AI analysis to track water quality in rivers and lakes.

stories.title: Mechademy raises $9.5 million for turbomachinery AI
stories.summary: Houston-based Mechademy has raised $9.5 million in a Series A round led by Silverton Partners. The startup is expanding its diagnostics platform, Turbomechanica, from oil and gas facilities into the power generation sector, citing growing electricity demand from data centers and AI infrastructure.

stories.title: VU Venture Partners enters India
stories.summary: US-based venture capital firm VU Venture Partners has entered the Indian startup market, targeting early-stage businesses with investments between $100,000 and $1 million. The firm, which has backed companies including OpenAI and SpaceX, plans to focus on nine sectors ranging from artificial intelligence to space and defence.

stories.title: GEF Capital Partners closes India climate fund at $615 million
stories.summary: Climate-focused private equity firm GEF Capital Partners has closed its fourth India-focused fund at $615 million, exceeding its initial target. The fund, which is 40 percent larger than its predecessor, will target mid-market growth-stage cleantech businesses across India and South Asia. The climate is currently attracting significant capital.

stories.title: SoftBank director to launch AI infrastructure fund
stories.summary: SoftBank Investment Advisers director Narendra Rathi is set to step down by the end of 2026. Rathi reportedly plans to launch a public markets fund focused on India’s AI infrastructure sector, targeting industrial companies and data centre suppliers. SoftBank has not commented on the departure.

stories.summary: VU Venture Partners is bringing its venture-capital accelerator and startup investment platform to India, targeting early-stage companies while training prospective investors through Venture University. stories.title: Swara Baby Products IPO details
stories.summary: Swara Baby Products will open its initial public offering on December 2, 2026, with a price band of 105 to 111 rupees per share. The company aims to raise 800 crore rupees through the issue, with listing on the NSE and BSE scheduled for December 9.

stories.title: Airpro Technology India IPO opens
stories.summary: Airpro Technology India has opened its SME initial public offering, aiming to raise 35.64 crore rupees. The company, which provides networking products, has set the issue price at 99 rupees per share. The IPO is scheduled to close on December 1, 2026.

stories.summary: Monomark Engineering plans to open its initial public offering on December 2, 2026, aiming to raise 175.50 crore rupees. The industrial services provider has set a price band of 60 to 65 rupees per share, with plans to list on the NSE and BSE.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields lists at discount
stories.summary: Shares of Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields listed at a 2 percent discount following its initial public offering. The issue was subscribed 1.5 times, with demand primarily driven by qualified institutional buyers. Retail interest remained below full subscription levels.

stories.title: IIT graduates launch breakfast subscription service in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Two childhood friends have launched Kinnow, a breakfast subscription service for working professionals in Bengaluru. The startup offers four-week meal plans including smoothies and yoghurt bowls. The founders, both IIT graduates, applied their professional problem-solving skills to the task of delivering morning meals to their own doorsteps.

stories.title: Cosine Robots raises Rs 22.36 crore for component manufacturing
stories.summary: Former Amazon and Google employees Kiran Mathew Koshy and Delip Thomas have raised Rs 22.36 crore for their Bengaluru robotics startup, Cosine Robots. The company plans to use the funding to build affordable robotics components, specifically focusing on the servo actuators that control movement in robotic systems.

stories.title: LinkedIn data shows 383% surge in Gen Z founders
stories.summary: The number of young professionals adding founder to their LinkedIn profiles has risen 383 percent since 2022. According to LinkedIn data, 94 percent of Gen Z respondents in India aspire to start a business, with seven in 10 planning to launch a venture within three years.

stories.title: Manufacturing startups gain momentum in India
stories.summary: Manufacturing startups now contribute 16 to 17 percent of India's GDP and employ over 27 million people. Gross Value Added in the sector grew at a compound annual growth rate of 10.88 percent between FY23 and FY26 as founders increasingly focus on domestic production and homegrown technologies.

stories.title: Entire partners with Sarvam to launch AI coding platform
stories.summary: Developer platform Entire is partnering with Sarvam to launch an agent-native Git forge in India. The collaboration aims to allow enterprises to host code locally while using AI-powered coding agents. The platform is founded by former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke to address demand for sovereign AI solutions.

stories.title: IIT Patna alumni raise Rs 22.36 crore for robotics venture
stories.summary: Cosine Robots has closed a funding round of Rs 22.36 crore led by Avaana Capital. The startup, founded in 2023 by two IIT Patna alumni, will use the capital to establish a research and production facility in Bengaluru and scale the manufacturing of its proprietary servo actuators.

stories.title: 16-year-old secures Y Combinator funding for missile startup
stories.summary: Henrijs Dandzbergs, a 16-year-old high school dropout, has secured 500,000 dollars from Y Combinator for his startup, Polemos Industries. The company aims to develop low-cost, AI-guided precision missiles that can be deployed using portable launchers. The teenager is currently participating in the Silicon Valley accelerator program.

stories.title: Cosine Robots pivots to components after humanoid ambitions
stories.summary: After initially setting out to build affordable humanoids, the founders of Cosine Robots have shifted focus to manufacturing servo actuators. The Bengaluru-based startup recently raised Rs 22.36 crore to produce these components, noting that the joints required for robotic movement represent a significant market opportunity.
